subject.title: feat(android): platform trust for public gateway certs + manual fingerprint pinning

question: Should Android adopt system certificate trust for eligible public gateway DNS names while retaining explicit pins only until users deliberately switch trust modes?
rationale: This changes the security and upgrade contract for gateway identity verification; source review can identify defects but cannot choose the product's permanent TLS trust policy.

options.title: Approve the hybrid trust policy after repair
options.body: Keep the explicit-pin-first behavior and permit platform trust only through the proposed eligible-host decision after the parser fix and device proof.

options.title: Keep pinning mandatory
options.body: Reject the system-trust route and retain fingerprint pinning for every Android gateway endpoint.

options.title: Narrow the scope
options.body: Land only the manual-pin recovery hardening and defer the public-certificate trust policy to a separately reviewed design.

recommendation.title: Approve the hybrid trust policy after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit-pin-first behavior and permit platform trust only through the proposed eligible-host decision after the parser fix and device proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Android TLS implementation and are the closest identified contributor for the policy discussion.
